title: Launcher live mode can't run one pinned live test: the live stage hardcodes the whole root_recovery_live suite and rejects filters
outcome: Launcher live mode can't run one pinned live test: the live stage hardcodes the whole root_recovery_live suite and rejects filters
acceptance: `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs live --engram-binary ABSOLUTE --engram-sha256 SHA256 -- NAME [NAME ...]` runs EXACTLY the named ignored tests of the root_recovery_live suite (the module mounted from src/tests/engram_root_recovery_live.rs, including its submodules). Each NAME is the test's FULL libtest path as `--list` reports it, matched with --exact, still --ignored and --test-threads=1, with the same binary-path, SHA-256, executable-probe, native Cargo and Git Bash verification before the stage as whole-suite mode. A pin mismatch is a terminal failed run with the stage unrun.

A filtered live run can never report success unless every named test ran: a syntactically invalid or duplicate name is refused before any run directory exists; a well-formed name that matches no test, or a libtest result whose passed+failed count differs from the number of names, ends as a terminal FAILED run that names the missing tests; a filter never silently runs zero tests.
Whole-suite mode (`live` with no names) is unchanged: the same stage command and arguments, prerequisite files, verification and result semantics; its existing launcher tests pass unchanged.

A filtered live run registers and records like any launcher run (RUN, TRACKED, results.json, summary), with the selected names in its request, results and summary; docs/test.md documents the filtered form and its zero-match rule next to the existing live command, and `usage` names it; credit follows the existing host rules for launcher runs in a named root, and this item changes no host credit logic.
The maintained full gate passes on the exact landed input, with an independent review pair clean on it.

completion.summary:
The launcher's pinned live mode can now run named live tests: `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs live --engram-binary ABS --engram-sha256 SHA -- NAME…`.
- It runs only the named ignored tests of the root_recovery_live suite, each by its full libtest path, with --exact under the same pin verification.
- Malformed, outside-the-suite or repeated names are refused before any run directory exists.
- The stage fails, naming the missing tests, unless every named test has a libtest result line and the counts cover exactly the names.
- The names are recorded in the request, results and summary, and docs/test.md documents the form. Whole-suite mode is unchanged, and no host logic changed.
